items.t: Spark plug blown out of the cylinder head
items.job: Repair spark plug threads with an insert, new plug and coil
items.note: If the threads are too damaged for an insert, the cylinder head must be replaced and the cost rises a lot.

items.t: Camshaft position sensor failure
Oil cooler and EGR cooler failure leading to head gasket trouble
items.job: Replace engine oil cooler and EGR cooler
items.note: If head gaskets have already failed, head studs and gaskets are needed and the cost rises a lot.

items.t: Injector control module (FICM) and injector failures
items.note: Test batteries first. If injectors have failed too, a set of eight costs far more.

items.t: Turbocharger vanes sticking from soot
items.job: Remove and clean turbo vanes, replace unison ring
items.note: If the turbo is worn out, a replacement turbo adds a good deal to the parts cost.

items.t: Radiator leaks, EGR cooler failure and fuel in the oil
items.note: EGR cooler replacement is a bigger job; if the cab must come off, expect much more.

items.t: Violent front-end shake ('death wobble')
items.job: Replace steering damper and track bar, then align
items.note: Worn ball joints, tie rods or bushings often need replacing too, which adds cost.

items.t: High-pressure fuel pump failure
items.job: Replace high-pressure pump, injectors and lines; clean fuel system
items.note: A failed pump usually spreads metal through the fuel system. Pump-only repair costs far less if caught early.

items.t: Rough or erratic automatic shifting
items.job: Update transmission software and replace solenoid body
items.note: Sometimes a software update alone fixes it. Internal damage means a rebuild at much higher cost.

items.t: Driveshaft damper can slip and break the driveshaft (recall)
items.note: Covered by a Ford safety recall. Check your VIN or ask a Ford dealer.

items.t: Tailgate can open on its own (recall)
items.job: Repair tailgate release switch and wiring
items.note: Covered by a Ford safety recall. Check your VIN or ask a Ford dealer.

items.t: Fuel pump deposits can cause stalling (recall)
items.note: Recall fix is a free software update. If the pump has already failed, fuel system repair costs far more.

items.t: 360-degree camera rear image too dark or washed out (recall)
items.note: Covered by a Ford safety recall. Check your VIN or ask a Ford dealer.

items.t: Steering column shaft bolts may be loose or missing (recall)
items.job: Inspect and install or tighten steering shaft bolts
items.note: Covered by a Ford safety recall. Check your VIN or ask a Ford dealer.

items.t: Rear axle shaft may break (recall)
items.note: Covered by a Ford safety recall. Check your VIN or ask a Ford dealer.

items.t: Infotainment screen can block the backup camera (recall)
items.note: Covered by a Ford safety recall. Check your VIN or ask a Ford dealer.

items.t: Analog gauges may stick or read wrong (recall)
items.note: Covered by a Ford safety recall. Check your VIN or ask a Ford dealer.

items.t: LED headlights may fail (recall)
items.note: Price is per side. Covered by a Ford safety recall; check your VIN or ask a Ford dealer.

items.t: Tailgate support cable may break under load (recall)
items.note: Covered by a Ford safety recall. Check your VIN or ask a Ford dealer.

items.t: Right rear axle shaft may break (recall)
items.note: Covered by a Ford safety recall. Check your VIN or ask a Ford dealer.

items.t: Spark plugs seize and break during removal
items.job: Replace spark plugs, extracting any broken plugs
items.note: Labor rises with each plug that breaks and needs the extraction tool.

items.t: Turbocharger failure on early 6.7L diesels
NOx sensor failure triggers reduced power
items.job: Replace NOx sensor and update software

items.t: Underbody insulator can wear through the aluminum driveshaft
items.job: Replace rear driveshaft and reposition insulator
items.note: Free under recall 22V-087. Check the VIN first.
